job_function: collateral management / margin operations analyst (daily variation margin calls)
control_point: Daily variation margin is computed per CSA threshold, minimum transfer amount and rounding, issued and agreed within the regulatory timeline.

citations.source_name: BCBS-IOSCO, Margin requirements for non-centrally cleared derivatives (BCBS d499, April 2020)

consequence_anchor.public_source: BCBS-IOSCO d499 and EMIR/CFTC uncleared-margin timelines: documented margin-call disputes, remediation and regulatory remediation orders
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: qualitative: operational remediation and counterparty dispute exposure; no fixed public tariff

commonality_rationale: Every bilateral derivatives relationship under uncleared margin rules computes, issues and agrees variation margin daily; the required timeline and CSA terms are identical across market participants.
